app.name: our-stream
app.tagline: Knowledge streams for teams: short clips, the right audience, answers you can trust.
status.heading: Status
status.apiUnreachable: The API is not reachable yet.
react.label: Reactions
comments.title: Comments on "{title}"
comments.disabled: Comments are turned off for this clip.
comments.removeBody: The text disappears for everyone; the thread keeps its shape.
comments.moreReplies: {count, plural, one {# more reply is} other {# more replies are}} not shown.
comments.pageNote: Up to {n} replies are shown per comment.
comments.uncertain: The server did not answer. Your comment is kept exactly as typed: retry it, or discard it.
comments.postedEarlier: Your earlier comment was already posted.
comments.unavailable: This clip is no longer available.
share.title: Share as a link
share.intro: Sends "{title}" as an in-app notification with a link. The link only works for people who can already see this clip.
share.nobody: Nobody else in your organisation yet.
share.notDelivered: Not delivered. The link below still works for you.
share.copyFailed: Copy did not work; select the link and copy it yourself.
search.title: Search
search.hint: Quotes keep a phrase together; a leading minus excludes a word.
search.total: {total, plural, =0 {No results} one {# result} other {# results}}
search.prompt: Type what you remember: a title, a phrase from the description or something that was said.
search.source.title: Title
search.deepLinkMissing: The clip from this link is not among these results.
prefs.heading: Email digest
prefs.intro: A daily email with the new clips and comments you have not seen. Turn it off to receive none.
org.title: Organisation settings
org.intro: Owners and admins only. Changes apply to everyone in the organisation.
org.forbidden: Only organisation owners and admins can change these settings.
org.privacyHint: "Named viewers" lists who watched a clip to its author. Required content does not exist yet, so the default behaves as counts only.
stats.heading: Engagement
stats.intro.aggregate_only: This organisation shows counts only; no viewer is named.
stats.intro.identified_for_required_only: Counts only for ordinary clips; viewers are named only on required content (not yet available).
stats.intro.named: This organisation names viewers to clip authors.
tags.heading: Event tags
tags.hint: Up to four tags; they appear in the feed and as search and feed filters.
pins.heading: Pins
pins.hint: A pinned clip is listed first under the Pinned filter for the people who can see it.
pins.noTargets: You cannot pin this clip anywhere: pinning needs a moderator role on one of its streams, or an organisation owner, admin or announcer role.
pins.notPublished: Publish the clip before pinning it.
filters.label: Feed filters
nav.signOutFailed: Sign-out failed; you are still signed in. Try again.
auth.signIn.title: Sign in
auth.signUp.title: Create your organisation
auth.signUp.intro: You become the first owner. Invite colleagues once you are in.
auth.orgSlugHint: 2–48 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens; used in links.
auth.slugInvalid: The short name may only contain lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.
auth.password.hint: At least {min} characters. A long phrase beats a short, complex one.
auth.password.tooShort: Too short: use at least {min} characters.
auth.password.weak: Weak: longer or more varied would help.
auth.emailRequiredForMagic: Enter your email first so we know where to send the link.
auth.magicSent: If that address belongs to an account, a sign-in link is on its way. Check your inbox.
auth.magic.title: Sign-in link
auth.magic.intro: Press the button to finish signing in.
auth.magic.missing: This link is missing or incomplete. Request a new one from the sign-in page.
account.title: Account
account.password.heading: Password
account.password.intro: Accounts created from an invitation have no password yet. Choose one here once; afterwards you can sign in with it or with an emailed link.
account.password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
account.password.tooLong: Too long: use at most {max} characters.
account.password.uncertain: The server did not answer. The password you typed may already have been saved, so it is kept exactly as typed: retry with it, or start over.
account.password.startedOver: Cleared. If the earlier attempt did reach the server, that password is the one in effect; if a new attempt is refused, sign in with it or with an emailed link.
account.password.set: Password set. You can now sign in with it.
account.password.setAfterRetry: Your earlier attempt did reach the server: the password you typed is in effect and you can sign in with it.
account.password.alreadySet: This account already has a password. Changing it from here is not available yet; if you have forgotten it, sign in with an emailed link.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.invalidCredentials: That email and password did not match.
error.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
error.notFound: That item could not be found.
error.slugTaken: That short name is already taken.
error.emailTaken: An account with that email already exists.
error.badRequest: Some of the details are not valid. Please check and try again.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
error.tokenInvalid: This link is no longer valid. Request a new one.
error.commentsDisabled: Comments are turned off for this clip.
error.commentBlocked: This comment was blocked by the organisation's content rules.
error.commentGone: That comment is no longer available.
error.idempotencyMismatch: Your earlier comment was already posted.
error.pinForbidden: You cannot pin this clip there.
error.notInAudience: This clip is not published to that stream.
error.unavailable: This clip is no longer available.
error.selfShare: You cannot share a clip with yourself.
streams.name: Name
streams.membersEmpty: Nobody has a role on this stream yet.
upload.intro: Upload a video or audio clip, add context, then choose who sees it.
upload.heading: New clip
upload.title: Title
upload.languageHint: BCP 47 code such as en or de-CH; used for captions.
upload.chaptersHint: Time as m:ss, for example 0:02 or 12:34 (h:mm:ss for longer clips), and a short title.
upload.chapterInvalid: Chapter time "{value}" is not valid; use m:ss such as 0:02.
upload.chapterIncomplete: Chapter {n} needs both a time and a title, or remove it.
upload.linkIncomplete: Link {n} needs an address, or remove it.
upload.dropHint: Choose a file or drop one here. Up to 4 GB.
upload.fileRequired: Choose a video or audio file first.
upload.unsupportedType: That file is not a video or audio type we can process.
upload.partMissing: The server did not provide an address for part {part}.
upload.pollingStalled: We stopped checking the processing status. Reload this page to see the latest state.
publish.title: Publish
publish.heading: Publish "{title}"
publish.notReady: This clip is still processing. You can publish once it is ready.
publish.groupsHint: Advanced: one group ID per line. Group management arrives with directory sync.
publish.groupInvalid: "{value}" is not a valid group ID.
publish.zoneHint: Times are in your time zone ({zone}).
publish.scheduleInvalid: Enter a valid date and time to schedule.
publish.expiryInvalid: Enter a valid expiry date and time, or leave it empty.
publish.expiryBeforePublish: The expiry must be after the publish time.
content.retractConfirmBody: It disappears from every feed immediately and viewers get a neutral notice. This cannot be undone.
feed.label: Clips
feed.playReducedMotion: Play (autoplay is off because your system prefers reduced motion)
feed.autoAdvance: Advance to the next clip automatically
feed.singleKeyShortcuts: Single-key shortcuts (J/K next and previous, C captions, M mute)
feed.shortcutsHelp: Arrow keys move between clips and Space plays or pauses whatever the setting.
feed.emptyBody: Clips published to you appear here.
feed.refreshed: The feed was refreshed because content or permissions changed.
feed.noLongerAvailable: A clip is no longer available and was removed from the feed.
feed.playbackError: This clip could not be played.
notifications.unreadCount: {count, plural, =0 {No unread notifications} one {# unread notification} other {# unread notifications}}
notifications.retracted: A clip you watched is no longer available.
notifications.publishedNeutral: A new clip was published to you.
